purpose: Descriptive test performance and full-test deployment parity; no accuracy floor or model selection.

metrics.missing_targets: Exclude NaN targets per head, retain all inputs/predictions; record n and missing count. Reject infinite targets or any nonfinite prediction.
metrics.undefined_correlation: null plus reason for fewer than two observations or a constant target/prediction
metrics.primary: raw checkpoint output against training-scale targets
metrics.secondary: clip predictions to [0,1] against the same targets, separately labelled; never overwrite raw outputs

parity.basis: Output bounds reuse the preserved SpCas9 export contract. Metric bounds are fixed before test inference; Spearman allows float32 near-tie rank changes. Every row and head must pass, with no aggregate masking.
comparisons: SpCas9 original TensorFlow vs export TensorFlow
SpCas9 original TensorFlow vs deployed torch
SpCas9 archived predictions vs original TensorFlow
Cas12a original TensorFlow vs deployed torch
parity.preprocessing: Exact float32 array equality between original encoding and deployed encoding for every test row and input.

spcas9.preprocessing: Saved published test.csv order, 30bp A/C/G/T one-hot (unknown bases zero), nine target columns divided by 100; no target clipping. Original test source checkpoint SHA must equal export.source SHA.
spcas9.selection: Preserved training log: validation loss, epoch 41; historical test result is an inherited evaluation, not a new independent study.

cas12a.preprocessing: Use preserved source_snapshot.zip cas12a.cnn_manifest verification and partition_arrays on test membership only; 34bp flank/PAM/guide/flank, ACGT float32 and 354 derived features. Original source excludes missing sequence/unparseable or missing target before splitting; finite targets divide by 100 and clip [0,1]. Reject any unexpected exclusion or missing test target.
cas12a.selection: Checkpoint already selected by lowest validation loss, epoch 5. Preserved validation_predictions.csv is selection evidence, never independent test evidence.
cas12a.provenance_limitation: Training source snapshot is retrospective (#117), with no contemporaneous attestation; test inference cannot repair historical training provenance.
